case_classification.short_description: Extensive inventory valuation with three different methods and further SKU categorization in 3 dimensions (partially also inventory valuation dependent)

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This is an exceptionally complex algorithm-heavy model requiring the perpetual daily valuation of 40 SKUs across three distinct methods (FIFO, LIFO, and Moving Average) over a full year, combined with multi-layered running ABC/XYZ/αβγ categorizations. Rebuilding the FIFO and LIFO layer stacks daily using cumulative consumption, resolving same-day multi-purchases in transaction order, and applying path-dependent Moving Average calculations requires writing sophisticated, custom LAMBDA/LET dynamic array formulas or debugging a complex VBA engine. Managing the precise tie-breaking logic based on the Products sheet index and mapping the strict threshold bands to answer the 70 granular date-and-SKU-specific questions pushes the execution time for even an expert modeler to three and a half hours.
